rules.description: Production backend changes must preserve architectural boundaries.
HTTP surface changes require focused presentation/integration verification and explicit snapshot review.

reviewObligations.description: Confirm whether Swagger-visible routes, payloads, status codes, or schemas changed; update contract snapshots when applicable.

rules.description: English and Russian UI locale files must change together.

reviewObligations.description: Verify Russian text renders without mojibake or replacement symbols.

rules.description: EF migrations require implementation/designer pairs and migration safety verification.

reviewObligations.description: Confirm migration and model snapshot classes remain excluded from code coverage.

rules.description: Frontend behavior changes require the full frontend verification pipeline before publication; visual-ui-change may use its focused completion gate locally because pre-push and CI run this check.

reviewObligations.description: For rendered UI changes, record route, affected viewport(s), interaction proof, console health, relevant keyboard/accessibility checks, and screenshot location. Require mobile evidence only for responsive or mobile scope; otherwise record it as out of scope.

rules.description: Authentication, billing, webhook, privacy, and personal-data changes require explicit security review.

reviewObligations.description: Review authorization, tenant/user scoping, replay/idempotency, secrets, sensitive logging, and personal-data handling as applicable.

rules.description: Query-shape and persistence changes require realistic provider-backed performance review.

reviewObligations.description: Review no-tracking, query count, Include/cartesian growth, bounded pagination, WHERE+ORDER BY index fit, provider translation, and realistic-cardinality coverage.

rules.description: Critical business and operational flow changes require telemetry outcome review.

reviewObligations.description: Confirm success/failure outcomes, duration where useful, low-cardinality dimensions, correlation, and exclusion of secrets or personal data.

rules.description: Durable boundary, ownership, deployment, consistency, or engineering-policy changes require an ADR decision.

reviewObligations.description: Decide whether this changes a durable system boundary, ownership, deployment, data consistency, public contract policy, or engineering policy; create/supersede an ADR when it does.

rules.description: NuGet dependency changes require graph, vulnerability, license, and compatibility review.

reviewObligations.description: Review direct/transitive changes, changelog and breaking behavior, lockfile consistency, license, platform/runtime compatibility, and package provenance.

rules.description: npm dependency and lockfile changes require graph, vulnerability, license, and compatibility review.

reviewObligations.description: Review direct/transitive changes, changelog and breaking behavior, lockfile consistency, license, platform/runtime compatibility, and package provenance.

rules.description: Configuration contract changes require synchronized templates, deployment values, validation, and secret-handling review.

reviewObligations.description: Synchronize option binding/validation, safe defaults, appsettings templates, environment examples, deployment values, secret storage, and startup/readiness behavior.

rules.description: Operationally sensitive changes require explicit rollout, verification, and rollback planning.

reviewObligations.description: Record deployment ordering, mixed-version compatibility, configuration/secrets, post-deploy signals, smoke checks, and a data-safe rollback or roll-forward strategy.

rules.description: Critical orchestration, transport, validation, persistence, and domain changes require explicit test-gap and complexity review.

reviewObligations.description: Review structural hotspot score, direct test references, boundary/error/concurrency scenarios, and whether focused coverage should be added or strengthened.

rules.description: External clients, webhooks, workers, jobs, and message processing require explicit resilience and delivery-semantics review.

reviewObligations.description: Review timeout/cancellation, retry and backoff, idempotency/replay, ordering, duplicate and partial delivery, dead-letter/recovery, graceful shutdown, readiness, and telemetry.

rules.description: Credential, identity, health, financial, messaging, export, and personal-data flows require lifecycle and disclosure review.

reviewObligations.description: Review minimization/purpose, consent or disclosure, authorization, storage/encryption, logs/cache/queues, provider sharing, export, retention/deletion, backups, and telemetry.

rules.description: Domain entities and value objects require invariant and state-transition review.

reviewObligations.description: Review construction and mutation paths, numeric/string boundaries, illegal state transitions, ownership scope, equality, serialization, and focused invariant tests.

rules.description: EF model configuration changes require domain/schema compatibility and query-shape review.

reviewObligations.description: Review keys, nullability, uniqueness, indexes, relationships, delete behavior, conversions, concurrency, generated migration, and realistic query shape.

rules.description: Project and module dependency changes must remain inside the executable architecture matrix.

reviewObligations.description: Review layer direction, necessity, allowed-matrix coverage, module cycles, cross-service client boundaries, and whether a durable ADR is required.

rules.description: Backend DTO, application abstraction, command/query/event, and client-package changes require consumer and serialization compatibility review.

reviewObligations.description: Query production/test consumers and review source/binary/serialization compatibility, nullability/defaults, enum evolution, cross-service rollout, and client-package versioning.

rules.description: Shared UI-kit changes require downstream selector-consumer and cross-surface verification.

reviewObligations.description: Query indexed consumers and review all affected selectors, input bindings, output handlers, projected content, styling hooks, main/admin surfaces, responsive behavior, and migration compatibility.

rules.description: Angular component and template changes require public contract, accessibility, and rendered-state review.

reviewObligations.description: Review selector, inputs, outputs, defaults, consuming templates, translation keys, and API call shape for compatibility.
Verify semantic roles, accessible names, keyboard navigation, focus behavior, disabled/error states, and responsive rendered evidence.

rules.description: Component stylesheet changes require rendered-state and accessibility review without implying a public Angular contract change.

reviewObligations.description: Verify semantic roles, accessible names, keyboard navigation, focus behavior, disabled/error states, and responsive rendered evidence.

rules.description: Knowledge-layer changes must remain deterministic and fresh.
